title: Research: exact three-source clean-cache interface
body:
## Contribution

Adds an exact three-source clean-cache helper contract. For three independent source lines, one clean coded line stores their sum, sends it to two distinct output registers, and is restored exactly. One additional clean helper coordinate is charged by raising the per-call centre cost from 64 to 65.

The completed local instance replaces six rank-2 channels with two rank-3 channels (load and restore) and two rank-1 output channels. It uses eight scalar additions per block versus six in the direct route; all source reads, restoration, helper hosting, frame behavior, and coefficient sizes are stated in the package. One helper is reused over 69 independent blocks.

## Conditional profile screen

The candidate profile is `{1:2550, 2:4, 3:570, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8}`. With the pinned `ceiling.ceiling()` model and centre 65, its exact α bracket is `[1721731989/10^12, 172173199/10^11]`, compared with `[1690054109/10^12, 169005411/10^11]` for the selected profile at centre 64. This is a 1.8744% increase in the fixed-word cap, still far below `1/99`.

This does not establish that 69 compatible bundles occur in the selected #1094 chronology or that the new helper satisfies its native phase, precision, and global-hosting contracts. No supplier integration, frontier change, or new κ is claimed.

## Verification

- `python3 -I -B research/complex-multisource-cache-seedab666b5/verify.py` — passes exact one- and 69-block endpoint checks, source immutability, clean restoration, and dirty-scratch, omitted-restore, and aliased-output controls.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-multisource-cache-seedab666b5 --check-only` — source pins and package metadata pass.
- `make selected-record-check` — selected record and κ pass unchanged.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay could not run locally because `python3.12` is not installed; the verifier passed under the available Python 3.14 runtime.

## Scope and overlap

The predecessor `research/complex-clean-cache-seed9df789` covers one source across two outputs and explicitly leaves multi-source coded scratch open. PR #1972 studies a P104 dirty-restored gather/query interface. Active Discussion #2032 studies three-source nonconsecutive gathers into one destination by rank-sum replacement and event commutation. This PR instead tests a new clean coded helper fanned to two outputs with exact restore; it does not claim a selected-word occurrence or search gather chronology.

Exact assignment, source, predecessor, certificate, result, and reproduction pins are recorded in `research/complex-multisource-cache-seedab666b5/`.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used; no independent human review is claimed.
